item.stickyfingers.stand_arrow.desc: Pierce yourself to awaken Sticky Fingers.
hud.stickyfingers.hidden: Inside the zipper… use Escape/Ambush again to emerge
screen.stickyfingers.wheel.hint: Release to select · inner ring: signature · outer ring: techniques
screen.stickyfingers.network.exit: Set as default exit (Escape / Teleport / your travel destination)
screen.stickyfingers.network.link: Link / unlink: click on one zipper, then another
screen.stickyfingers.network.empty: No active zippers. Place some with your abilities!
message.stickyfingers.cooldown: That ability is still on cooldown.
message.stickyfingers.disabled: That ability is disabled on this server.
message.stickyfingers.out_of_range: That zipper is out of range.
message.stickyfingers.travel_first: Zipper #%s placed. Place a second zipper to connect them.
message.stickyfingers.permanent: This doorway stays open until you close it (sneak-use while aiming at it).
commands.stickyfingers.restored: Restored every zipper-separated block in this dimension
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_open.desc: Unzip a block, surface, container or door. The seam parts so you can see and walk inside. Auto-closes; links to a waiting Travel zipper.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_door.desc: Unzip a 2x3 doorway straight through a wall. Sneak-use to leave it open until you close it.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_storage.des: Open a pocket of zipper space that holds 27 stacks of anything, kept between sessions.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_travel.desc: Place zipper A, then zipper B. They link both ways: walk through one, step out of the other.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_restraint.d: Stitch a target to the surrounding terrain with zipper chains. Immobilized and unmovable.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_punch.desc: The Stand unleashes a blistering barrage ending in a launching blow that unzips the target.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_teleport.de: Get pulled into a zipper and burst out of the one you aim at, your marked target or your exit zipper.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_trap.desc: Hide a zipper in the ground. The first creature to step near is swallowed and bound.
Fling a glowing slider. On hit it unzips and marks the target; Teleport then takes you to it.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_network.des: Open the network map: every zipper's ID, links, exit choice and travel.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_world.desc: ULTIMATE. Slam the world and cover the battlefield in seams, warp through them in a storm of blows, then close it all.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_mob.desc: Unzip a creature: frozen and covered in seams. Right-click it while open to climb inside and ride hidden; sneak to unzip out.
ability.stickyfingers.aerial_zipper.desc: Unzip empty air into a floating platform and portal anchor.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_escape.desc: Unzip yourself and vanish into zipper space. Use again to emerge at your exit zipper.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_body.desc: Unzip your own body: shrink your hitbox to slip through gaps and phase around attacks. Use again to stop.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_decoy.desc: Leave a stitched copy of yourself behind and slip out of a nearby zipper. Enemies chase the decoy.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_slice.desc: Run a zipper straight through a structure and pull its halves apart for a while.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_combo.desc: A cinematic chain: zippers ring the target, rapid punches, warps through seams, and a final launching blow.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_ambush.desc: Hide in zipper space, then burst out behind the nearest enemy.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_wall.desc: Unzip a large 3x4 passage through a barrier. It seals again when closed.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_floor.desc: Unzip the ground into a shaft and drift down it. Seals when closed.
ability.stickyfingers.zipper_repair.desc: Close every nearby zipper at once: separated blocks stitch back together and targets are released.
message.stickyfingers.no_target: Nothing to unzip there — aim at a block, wall or creature in range.
message.stickyfingers.inside: You slipped inside %s. Sneak to unzip yourself out.
